importantNotice: This catalogue records recovered claims and their authority. It is not a complete machine-executable semantic model. A canonical source label does not imply that every related implementation rule has been specified.

statusDefinitions.canonical: Explicitly present in supplied v3.0 or v3.0-L canonical specification.
statusDefinitions.provisional: Explicitly marked provisional, or an audit proposal not promoted to canon.
statusDefinitions.open: Named or implied by the sources but not sufficiently specified to implement safely.
statusDefinitions.unverified: A claim about implementation or validation for which no execution evidence exists.

rules.statement: Information, mana, energy, force, coupling, and effect are distinct concepts.
Mana is a physical field and does not understand meaning or intent.
A desired effect is not itself a physical mechanism; state transitions require a defined mechanism.
Magic does not provide free energy, matter, momentum, or information; closed-system conservation and valid conversion mechanisms apply.
Spell feasibility considers mana, coupling, energy, information, control, time/causality, stability, and material constraints.
NULL is a failure of conventional affinity classification, not zero mana, anti-magic, hidden infinite affinity, immunity, or omnipotence.
Arcane is a human-designed control language; language, spell, and mana are distinct.
Arcane's intended surface structure is HEAD + ARGUMENTS + MODIFIERS; precise grouping and scope are not fully recovered.
Every executable expression must have exactly one recoverable interpretation; unresolved ambiguity must fail rather than guess.
Formal expressions are intended to be typed; incompatible operands must not be silently accepted.
FRAPA, FRATA, FRAKA, FRALA, FRASHA, DRAN, DREM, DRIM and DRAL are recovered mathematical operators.
The Phase 2 operator signatures and OPERATOR⟨arguments⟩ notation are provisional audit proposals, not established surface grammar.
FRAPA has a proposed binary signature; dimensional and quantity compatibility remain unresolved.
KWAM creates a binding, KWAT references a binding, and KWAK denotes live evaluation; exact representation and timing semantics remain incomplete.
v2.0 frame-vowel-coda morphology, h coupling, MEL anchoring, and KAN/KEN/KAS are not sufficiently recovered to implement.
KREN, TRAK, FREM, SHREN, BRAN, and VARE appear in the magic-system operator inventory but are absent from the supplied v3.0-L core inventory; reconcile by evidence, not assumption.
A test definition is not a test execution, and no test may be labelled passed without recorded execution evidence.
Changes must state the existing rule/source, concrete defect, alternatives, tests/results, decision status, date, and rationale.
The recovered base-unit symbols MA, SE, KE, KU and RA are recorded, but complete conversion and derived-unit semantics remain open.
Dimensional multiplication/division may derive exponent vectors without choosing an unapproved canonical derived-unit spelling.

tests.description: Binary arity: FRAPA has exactly two arguments in Phase 2 audit notation.
Missing or extra FRAPA arguments are rejected in the provisional audit parser.
Nested expressions produce a single explicit parse tree; malformed grouping is rejected.
Dimensional type mismatch is rejected only after the relevant type and dimension rules are specified.
Operand order is preserved for order-sensitive operators such as FRATA.
KWAM/KWAT/KWAK binding and evaluation semantics require separate tests once representation and timing are defined.
Concepts such as mana, energy, coupling and effect remain distinct in the rule model.
An effect specification without a physical mechanism is incomplete.
Energy and matter changes require a source or a valid conversion mechanism.
Recognise the five unit symbols recovered in v3.0-L: MA, SE, KE, KU, RA.
Reject addition of quantities with incompatible dimensions.
Multiply lengths to produce a squared-length dimension vector without inventing a unit spelling.
Divide length by time to produce a velocity dimension vector.
Reject division by zero and unknown unit symbols.
